headline: Finding the signal in public language.
subhead: SIGNAL studies how communication shapes markets, firms, public decisions, and opinion.
about: SIGNAL is a research program of the Davi Moreira Research Lab and an Interdisciplinary Research Generator of Purdue University's John Martinson Honors College for AY 2026–2028. It asks how the words that institutions, firms and people put on the public record shape what happens next, using regulatory comments, consumer complaints, corporate disclosures and health marketing claims.
